---
name: Fix a failing test
about: Report or claim a fix for a solution whose automated test is failing
title: "[Fix]: Failing test for practice<n> (<language>)"
labels: bug, help wanted, good first issue
---

## Which solution or test is failing?

Give the solution and test paths (e.g. `solutions/python/practice42.py` and `tests/python/test_practice42.py`).

## Failure output

Paste the command you ran (for example `pytest tests/python/test_practice42.py`) and the error or assertion output.

## Root cause (if known)

Is the bug in the solution logic, or is the expected output in the test file wrong?
